name: Ballst
tagline: The operating system for enterprise marina and harbor operators.
positioning: Ballst unifies berth allocation, fuel dock metering, and slip revenue across multi-site marina portfolios into one governed platform.

hero.h1: Run every berth, dock, and slip from one system of record
hero.sub: Ballst gives multi-site marina operators governed control over berth allocation, fuel metering, and slip billing — with the audit trail your finance and compliance teams demand.

features.title: Portfolio berth allocation
features.description: Assign and reconcile transient and contract berths across every location from a single dispatch console, with vessel dimensions and draft enforced automatically.

features.title: Metered fuel dock billing
features.description: Capture pump throughput in real time and post per-gallon charges directly to the guest folio — no reconciliation spreadsheet, no end-of-day drift.

features.title: Occupancy analytics
features.description: Track slip utilization, revenue per linear foot, and seasonal turn rates across your entire portfolio with board-ready reporting.

features.title: Governed access controls
features.description: Role-based permissions, SSO, and immutable change logs keep dockmasters, accounting, and regional directors in their lane.

features.title: Storm and haul-out scheduling
features.description: Coordinate hurricane hauls, yard slots, and dry-stack retrievals with capacity-aware queues that flag conflicts before they happen.

features.title: Marine services API
features.description: Sync with fuel telemetry, gate access, and marine POS through a documented API so your existing hardware stays in the loop.

testimonials.quote: Before Ballst we reconciled fuel dock revenue across nine marinas by hand every Monday. Now metering posts to the folio at the pump and our regional close takes hours, not days.
testimonials.name: Diane Whitcombe

testimonials.quote: We evaluated four platforms. Ballst was the only one that modeled contract berths, transients, and dry-stack in a single allocation engine we could actually audit.
testimonials.name: Marcus Deveraux

testimonials.quote: The change log alone justified the deal. When a berth assignment gets overridden, I know who did it and why. Our auditors stopped asking questions.
testimonials.name: Priya Ramanathan
